messages.content: Hi Sir, I am Lee Hui Min from enterprise 5G provisioning team. 我要 create UDM subscription order 给一个 new corporate client — Sunway Group, 10000 MSISDN bulk slice。**请帮我 search 可用 offers 先 lah**, 然后 we discuss next step, urgent ya CFO 等 quote 给 board meeting tomorrow。
Hello Madam Lee, good afternoon。Understood, search UDM offers for enterprise 5G bulk slice first。请稍等一下。
